comment: A second held-out set for topic selection (the Jev spike, docs/JEV-SPIKE.md), written after the topic question gained its request check and never tuned on. Same shape as topics_labeled.json: the authored topic that answers the line for a fresh player, or null.

items.says: is the big tower clock ever going to run again?
whose ladder did you learn your trade under? who trained you?
what's the little stopped clock you keep apart from the others?
what happened on the night of the big freeze?
do you know the old fellow with the broom?
which way to the top of the tower?
please oil my squeaky pocket watch
I love how quiet it is up here
may I hold one of the resting clocks for a moment?
why keep all these paper hours in glass?
is there tea going?
who dreamed this whole village up?
what do the tags on the jars say?
what's that jar sitting all alone at the very top?
how do hours end up lost in the first place?
could you unlock that cabinet for me?
it smells of old paper down here
do you ever get up early enough to see the morning?
do all the lamps have names?
who looks after the guest hours at the Waiting House?
what are the little fluttering things around the lights?
tell me about the clockmaker up in the loft
hand me your pole, I want to try
good night, Bell
what are all the unsent notes waiting for?
what are the little wooden cubbies for?
does the keeper of the hour cellar ever come by?
can you find me a stamp?
what a cozy little office
do you keep anything special in that tin of yours?
what's this dusty old room with all the shavings?
did the missing clock part ever turn up?
sweep that corner for me, would you?
you don't talk much, do you

what falls into your net at dusk?
what's across the bridge over the river?
did you know the one who built the great clock?
teach me to swing the net
the grass is so soft out here
